reference.title: Blood pressure response index trajectories identify distinct hemodynamic phenotypes and predict mortality in septic shock: a two-database retrospective cohort study

disposition_definition: Fixed class while alive and ICU-resident at each checkpoint; live ICU exit and exact ICU death are absorbing; uncertain date-only exit outcome remains unknown
treatment_scope: Both complete assigned cohorts; first-day [0,24 h) treatment intensity; admission Day 28 all-cause death and complete index-ICU outcomes
cutpoint_selection: Fixed study-defined clinical categories; no outcome-based optimisation

treatment_intensity.label: First-day treatment intensity

hierarchy.Max: CRRT or invasive MV with maximum NEE >0.3 µg/kg/min
hierarchy.High: Below Max: NEE >0.3 or invasive MV with 0<NEE≤0.3 µg/kg/min
hierarchy.Medium: Below Max/High: invasive MV with NEE=0, isolated 0<NEE≤0.3, or high net fluid balance
hierarchy.Low: No recorded MV/CRRT, NEE=0, and low net fluid balance

treatment_intensity.fluid_rule: High if >30 mL/kg with valid 20–300 kg weight; if weight invalid/missing use >2,000 mL; low includes equality
treatment_intensity.unknown: Only no recorded MV/CRRT/NEE with missing fluid documentation, preventing Low/Medium separation
treatment_intensity.selection: User-confirmed organ-support-first descriptive hierarchy; identical in both databases; no outcome optimisation

zero_semantics: Zero NEE/MV/CRRT denotes no recorded receipt. Intensity is unknown only with no recorded MV/CRRT/NEE and missing fluid documentation; organ support or positive NEE determines intensity despite missing fluid
flow_coloring: Persistent source Class 1/2/3; downstream node fills identify exposure/outcome
node_percentages: 100 × node count / panel cohort_stays, rounded to one decimal; denominator fixed across all stages within each panel
